name: Levites The
overview: The Levites, descended from Jacob's third son, were uniquely chosen by God for service in the sanctuary and were not included in the general census of Israel, as shown in Numbers 1:47-49. Their commitment to the Lord was demonstrated decisively in Exodus 32 when they rallied to Moses' call and executed judgment upon the idolatrous, underscoring their role as God's instruments of holiness and justice. This distinct calling set them apart to serve the tabernacle, guarding its sanctity and leading the people in worship.
